subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Has two strings to his bow**

options.text: He is indecisive in crucial matters.
He has two romantic interests simultaneously.
He has an additional skill or option to rely on.
He uses deception to achieve goals.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. He has an additional skill or option to rely on .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"has two strings to his bow"** refers to having an additional skill or option to rely on.
 
• It originates from archery, where having two strings for a bow ensures a backup if one string fails.
 
• This idiom is often used figuratively to describe someone with a backup plan or an extra skill that can be utilized when needed.

Correct interpretation: *"He has an additional skill or option to rely on."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He is indecisive in crucial matters" - This is incorrect as it does not relate to the meaning of the idiom.
 
• **Option 2:** "He has two romantic interests simultaneously" - This is incorrect and unrelated to the idiom's meaning.
 
• **Option 4:** "He uses deception to achieve goals" - This is incorrect as the idiom does not imply deceit.
